indexes.name: Wishlist_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Wishlist_pkey" ON public."Wishlist" USING btree (id)

indexes.name: Wishlist_userId_subjectId_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Wishlist_userId_subjectId_key" ON public."Wishlist" USING btree ("userId", "subjectId")

indexes.name: Withdrawal_createdAt_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX "Withdrawal_createdAt_idx" ON public."Withdrawal" USING btree ("createdAt")

indexes.name: Withdrawal_createdAt_month_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX "Withdrawal_createdAt_month_idx" ON public."Withdrawal" USING btree (EXTRACT(month FROM "createdAt"), EXTRACT(year FROM "createdAt"))

indexes.name: Withdrawal_paymentMethod_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX "Withdrawal_paymentMethod_idx" ON public."Withdrawal" USING btree ("paymentMethod")

indexes.name: Withdrawal_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Withdrawal_pkey" ON public."Withdrawal" USING btree (id)

indexes.name: Withdrawal_status_createdAt_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX "Withdrawal_status_createdAt_idx" ON public."Withdrawal" USING btree (status, "createdAt")

indexes.name: Withdrawal_status_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX "Withdrawal_status_idx" ON public."Withdrawal" USING btree (status)

indexes.name: Withdrawal_userId_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX "Withdrawal_userId_idx" ON public."Withdrawal" USING btree ("userId")

indexes.name: idx_testimonials_landing
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_testimonials_landing ON public.testimonials USING btree (is_published, display_order) WHERE (is_published = true)

indexes.name: testimonials_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX testimonials_pkey ON public.testimonials USING btree (id)
